name: GRAD 6002
title: Reflections on Teaching Practice
description: Students in this seminar examine and discuss various issues of curriculum and teaching practice related to university level courses.  Through a systematic process of problem-posing, reflection, and group feedback, students formulate practical solutions to problems occurring during curriculum development, instruction, materials use, teacher-student interactions, course management, and program administration.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
